title: Add optional LLM helper for task comparison and summary drafting

sections.what: Allow local/API LLM assistance for nuanced duplicate explanation and legacy card cleanup.

acceptance.text: Works cleanly offline when no LLM server is configured
Explains merge or supersede rationale cleanly

evidence: Added src/taskweave/llm.py with OpenAI-compatible explain_task_comparison and draft_task_summary that degrade cleanly offline.
Wired explain=True / --explain into service.find_similar_tasks, service.draft_summary, and cli.py `similar --explain`.
